verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a pre-configured Postman workspace for exploring and testing API endpoints, which provides runnable, interactive API calls. However, nothing shows an interactive "try it" console inside its own API reference, and the explorer depends on an external tool. missing for 10: in-docs interactive API reference with runnable examples, detail on what the Postman workspace covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore and test API endpoints with our pre-configured Postman workspace.
